name: Vietnam — 1 July 2026

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.
vanban.chinhphu.vn — the Government document database. /?pageid=27160&docid=<id> is an instrument page (number, dates, effective date) and links its text at datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/<yyyy>/<mm>/<file>.pdf. Many texts are scanned gazette copies with no text layer (Law 109/2025, 6.5 MB) — the reader cannot read those; cite the instrument page for dates and take the wording from a government portal below. Known ids: 198540 Bộ luật Lao động 45/2019, 210536 NĐ 74/2024, 215832 NĐ 293/2025, 214560 Luật Việc làm 74/2025, 216495 Luật Thuế TNCN 109/2025, 218107 NĐ 161/2026, 218684 NĐ 253/2026, 217500 NĐ 105/2026, 216497 Luật Dân số 113/2025, 218008 NQ 28/2026.
congbao.chinhphu.vn — the Official Gazette (Công báo): search by số ký hiệu; the issue PDF is the gazette copy.
xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn and baochinhphu.vn — the Government portals: full-text articles quoting the instrument (tables of the PIT scale, minimum wages, holiday notices) in HTML; official, and the readable text where the gazette copy is a scan.
baohiemxahoi.gov.vn — Vietnam Social Security: /tintuc/Pages/linh-vuc-bao-hiem-xa-hoi.aspx?ItemID=<n>&CateID=168 announces the reference level, floors and caps.
nief.mof.gov.vn — the Ministry of Finance institute; summaries of tax law. luatvietnam.vn, thuvienphapluat.vn and hethongphapluat are commercial and corroboration only (thuvienphapluat answers 403).

Finding changes (read these before comparing, every run):
Every month open vanban.chinhphu.vn/he-thong-van-ban?classid=1&mode=1&orggroupid=2 (decrees) and ...&typegroupid=3 (laws). Rows are 'số ký hiệu | ngày ban hành | trích yếu', newest first. Flag anything whose title mentions lương tối thiểu, lương cơ sở, mức tham chiếu, bảo hiểm xã hội/y tế/thất nghiệp, thuế thu nhập cá nhân, giảm trừ gia cảnh, công đoàn, nghỉ lễ/Tết, or Bộ luật Lao động. Open the item page (?pageid=27160&docid=N) for the effective date. The site search does not work through the URL (keyword params are ignored), so scan the lists. Next read congbao.chinhphu.vn/cac-van-ban-moi-ban-hanh.rss and the Bộ Nội vụ (c5) and Bộ Tài chính (c10) gazette lists for MOHA/MOF circulars. Congbao item pages link a .docx, so use it when the vanban PDF is a scan. For VSS rules read baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/vanban/Pages/default.aspx. For readable wording and the Tết/holiday decisions read xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/chinh-sach-moi.rss and baochinhphu.vn topic pages. gdt.gov.vn, mof.gov.vn, moha.gov.vn and phapluat.gov.vn listings cannot be read, so do not use them. Discovery only (always cite the vanban/congbao instrument): kpmg.com/vn insights. Treat a Bộ Nội vụ 'đề xuất' or a National Wage Council recommendation as pending until the Nghị định exists.

change_summary: 1 July 2026: Decree 161/2026 raises the reference level to 2,530,000, so the SI/HI/union-fee cap becomes 50,600,000; Decree 253/2026 implements the PIT law, including the whole-overtime-wage exemption (Law 109/2025 art.4(8)); the salary PIT return becomes quarterly (Circular 89/2026/TT-BTC art.22(1)(a)(a.1)); the Law on Population 113/2025 gives a second child 7 months’ maternity and 10 days’ paternity; Nghị quyết 28/2026 adds 24 November as a paid holiday.

employment_type.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.20: PERMANENT is an indefinite-term contract, CONTRACT a fixed term of at most 36 months; PROBATION (art.24–27), PART_TIME (art.32), INTERN (art.61) and DOMESTIC (art.161, outside unemployment insurance).

work_classification.description: Labour Code art.113(1): 12 days of annual leave for ordinary work, 14 for heavy, hazardous or dangerous (ARDUOUS) and 16 for especially heavy, hazardous or dangerous work.

residency_status.description: CITIZEN: a Vietnamese citizen resident for PIT (also in unemployment insurance). PERMANENT_RESIDENT: a foreigner with a permanent residence card (PIT resident). RESIDENT: another foreigner resident for PIT (183 days in the year or a home for 183 days). NON_RESIDENT: taxed at 20% with no deductions. PIT refuses any other value: the law presumes neither.

prior_floor_region.title: Worksite region on 31 December 2025
prior_floor_region.description: Decree 293/2025 art.5(5): the worksite's minimum-wage region under the prior order, read for an incumbent whose area was reclassified lower.

prior_floor_reclassified.title: Area reclassified lower in 2026
prior_floor_reclassified.description: True only when the same worksite was assigned a lower 2026 region by the decree.

probation_class.title: Probation job class (Labour Code art.25)
probation_class.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: probation at most 180 days for an enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises, Law on State Capital), 60 days for a job needing college-level or higher qualifications, 30 days for intermediate-level, technical-worker or clerical jobs, 6 working days for any other job. Record it on probation terms.

probation_job_wage.title: Wage of the job on probation
probation_job_wage.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.26: the probation wage is at least 85% of the wage of that job. Record the job’s agreed wage on probation terms.

normal_hours_arrangement.title: Normal working-time arrangement
normal_hours_arrangement.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.105(1)–(2): daily arrangement allows at most eight normal hours a day; weekly arrangement allows at most ten, both at most 48 a week. Unrecorded arrangement defaults to DAILY.

normal_hours_notified_on.title: Working-time arrangement notified on
normal_hours_notified_on.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.105(2): record when the worker was notified of the selected daily or weekly arrangement. A date records the notification; retain delivery evidence separately.

pension_eligible.title: Qualifies for a pension on leaving
pension_eligible.description: Labour Code 2019 art.46(1): no severance allowance where the employee qualifies for a pension under the social insurance law (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.64).

absent_five_days.title: Dismissed for five days' unexcused absence
absent_five_days.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(e): the employer ended the contract after five consecutive working days absent without good reason; art.46(1) owes no severance allowance.

final_settlement_extended.title: Settlement period extended to 30 days
final_settlement_extended.description: Labour Code 2019 art.48(1): settlement within 14 working days of termination; only art.48(1)(a), (c), (d) — the employer ceased operating; a merger, division, sale or transfer; natural disaster, fire, enemy action or epidemic — allow up to 30 days. Unrecorded is the 14-day rule.

exit_facts.description: Stored on employment_contract.exit_facts when the contract closes.

kind.description: The standing in the scheme, e.g. MEMBER or EXEMPT.

reference_number.description: The scheme registration number (SI book number, tax code).

union_member.title: Trade union member
union_member.description: UNION_DUES standing: a member pays 0.5% of the insurance salary, at most 10% of the reference level (Law 50/2024 art.29(1)(a); Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ).

dependants.title: Registered dependants
dependants.description: PIT standing: each dependant registered with the tax authority is a monthly family deduction of 6,200,000 (Resolution 110/2025).

finalisation_authorised.title: Authorises the employer PIT finalisation
finalisation_authorised.description: PIT standing: the employer finalises the year only for an employee who authorised it (Decree 126/2020 art.8(6)(d); Decree 253/2026 art.51 from 2026).

voluntary_pension_contribution.title: Voluntary pension / life-insurance contribution (VND a month)
voluntary_pension_contribution.description: PIT standing: the employee’s own monthly contribution to supplementary pension, voluntary pension or life insurance, deducted up to 3,000,000 a month (Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.46(2)(a)).

commitment_form.title: Commitment form 08/CK-TNCN filed
commitment_form.description: PIT standing: a resident on no contract or one under three months who expects no taxable income after the family deduction; the 10% withholding is suspended (Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.50(2)).

unpaid_leave_continuation.title: SI continued through unpaid leave by agreement
unpaid_leave_continuation.description: SI standing: the parties agreed to keep paying compulsory SI for a month with 14 or more unpaid working days (Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.33(5), 34(3)). Unrecorded is the exemption.

facts.description: Person facts: the other keys of employment_profile.facts (CEL employee.facts.*).

si_contribution_years.title: Years of social-insurance contribution
si_contribution_years.description: SICK_LEAVE: 30 working days a year under 15 years of compulsory SI contribution, 40 from 15 to under 30, 60 from 30 — 10 more for arduous or especially arduous work (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.43(1)). Unrecorded meters the 60-day band, so no lawful day is refused.

overtime_300h_sector.title: Eligible for 300 annual overtime hours
overtime_300h_sector.description: Labour Code 2019 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 overtime hours a year; art.107(3) allows 300 only in the listed sectors and cases (Decree 145/2020 art.61), and art.107(4) only after notifying the provincial labour authority. Unrecorded is the general 200-hour limit.

rest_averaged_monthly.title: Rest averaged monthly
rest_averaged_monthly.description: Labour Code 2019 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; only where the work cycle cannot allow weekly rest may the employer average it to at least four days a month. Unrecorded is the weekly rule.

occupational_accident_reduced.title: Approved reduced occupational accident rate
occupational_accident_reduced.description: Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP art.4(1): the occupational accident and disease fund rate is 0.5% of the salary; the reduced 0.3% applies only to an employer the Ministry approved on application (art.4(1)(b), art.5). Unrecorded is the 0.5% rate.

union_fee_suspended.title: Union fee suspended by decision
union_fee_suspended.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.13: the Vietnam General Confederation of Labour or the provincial federation may suspend the 2% union fee, by month and for at most 12 months, for an enterprise or cooperative in difficulty from restructuring, technological change, economic crisis, State restructuring policy, natural disaster, fire, epidemic or crop failure that meets art.13(2). Record it only for the decision’s months; unrecorded is the fee in full. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf

union_fee_reduction_percent.title: Union fee reduction by decision (%)
union_fee_reduction_percent.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.12: after an art.13 suspension ends, an enterprise or cooperative that must still cut its workforce by the art.12(1) threshold may be granted a reduction of at most 20% of the 2% fee (art.12(3)), by month and for at most 6 months (art.12(2)(a)), by decision of the Confederation or the provincial federation. Record the decided percentage only for those months; unrecorded is 0. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf

pit_quarterly_filer.title: Declares salary PIT quarterly (quarterly VAT filer)
pit_quarterly_filer.description: Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14 art.44(1)(a)–(b) with Decree 126/2020/NĐ-CP arts.8(1), 9: a payer eligible to declare VAT quarterly may declare salary PIT quarterly; unrecorded is the monthly return by the 20th. From 1 July 2026 (Circular 89/2026/TT-BTC art.22(1)(a)(a.1)) every salary payer declares quarterly and this input is not read.

stoppage_pay_percent.title: Agreed stoppage pay (% of the contract wage)
stoppage_pay_percent.description: Labour Code 2019 art.99(2)–(3): for a stoppage caused by a co-worker or an objective cause the parties agree the stoppage wage, not below the regional minimum wage (for a longer stoppage, the first 14 working days). STOPPAGE_REDUCTION deducts the difference between the contract day wage and the larger of this share and the regional minimum day wage (company.region). Unrecorded is full pay.

six_monthly_health_checks.title: Six-monthly health checks
six_monthly_health_checks.description: Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.21(1): health checks at least once a year, every six months for heavy, hazardous or dangerous work, minors, the disabled and the elderly. Set when the entity employs any of them; unrecorded raises the yearly check only.

vss_unit_code.title: Vietnam Social Security unit code
vss_unit_code.description: The employer’s SI/HI/UI unit code (mã đơn vị) with Vietnam Social Security (Law 41/2024 art.28).

tax_code.title: Enterprise tax code
tax_code.description: The employer’s tax identification number for PIT withholding returns.

pdpl_exempt.title: Exempt from PDPL dossier and personnel duties
pdpl_exempt.description: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 art.38(2)–(3): a household business or micro-enterprise is exempt, and a small enterprise or startup may opt out for 5 years from 1 January 2026, from the impact assessment (arts.21–22) and the data-protection personnel (art.33(2)) duties — unless it processes sensitive data or the data of a large number of subjects, or provides data-processing services. Unrecorded is not exempt.

state_owned_enterprise.title: State-owned enterprise
state_owned_enterprise.description: UNION_DUES: in a State enterprise members pay 0.5% of the take-home salary after SI, HI, UI and PIT, at most 10% of the base salary (Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ); elsewhere 0.5% of the SI salary.

union_fee_quarterly.title: Union fee paid every three months
union_fee_quarterly.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.4(1)(b), (2)(b): an agricultural, forestry, fishery or salt employer paying wages by production cycle may register with the union to pay every three months, by the last day of the month after the cycle. Unrecorded is monthly.
